metadata.description: Opt-in skill bundles from gigabrain/library. Mirrors library/plugins.json; bin/check-library.py fails if names, sources or descriptions drift.

plugins.name: knowledge

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: React and UI work: React patterns, performance and testing, Playwright E2E, accessibility, interface polish. Enabled by kit for the react stack.

plugins.name: go

plugins.description: Containers and deployment: Docker/Compose, CI/CD and rollout patterns, Kubernetes. Enabled by kit for the docker, k8s, aws and terraform stacks.
